summary: Completed the Shop Categories Migration plan end-to-end. Backend schema, migration, shops/offers modules, and seed were already done; this turn finished all mobile work: updated api-types, mappers, and ShopSummary/SellerOffer types for shop-owned categories; added multi-select category picker to create-shop; removed category fields from create/edit offer forms; added getUniqueShopCategories and rewired seller filter context, category picker, and filter bar to use only categories assigned to the shopkeeper's shops (mirroring location filter UX with hide/static/tappable states and 'Showing shops in' copy).
current_status: All six plan todos are complete. Categories now live on shops via ShopCategory junction; offers inherit categorization through their shop. Buyer browse still filters by categoryId query param; seller dashboard filters locations and categories from owned shops only. Re-run `bunx prisma db seed` if local DB needs refreshed shop category data.
